clusters.title: Miles MI35x: 6 MoE Megatron tests hang in the RCCL watchdog — 1 job

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:
First seen in ML10n (image `20261103`, node `mia1-p02-g13`). The job log has 41 `Watchdog caught collective` lines; every earlier part 2/2 log has 0.
The same 6 tests passed in the Nov 2 dispatch run on image `20261102`, which has the same sglang commit.
The hangs used up the 180-minute step limit, so 4 more tests never finished.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[LOW]`: no change is blamed. A transient GPU or RCCL fault on g13 GPUs 0–3 hung every MoE expert-parallel `ALLTOALL_BASE`. **Disconfirming**: g13 passed the same partition on Oct 28, and the log has no HW or RCCL error. An alternative `[LOW]` hypothesis: the unpinned Megatron-LM clone picked up [radixark/Megatron-LM#137](https://github.com/radixark/Megatron-LM/pull/137) ([`eb547f33e1`](https://github.com/radixark/Megatron-LM/commit/eb547f33e183479530cfb5428b7c665a110c785f)) and #136.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found. [radixark/miles#4630](https://github.com/radixark/miles/pull/4630) is only a DO-NOT-MERGE test of #136 and #137.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: rerun part 2/2 with the same image digest `79711b31…` on a node other than g13. If the hang reproduces, rebuild the image with Megatron-LM pinned to `fdf8235667`.

details.label: R378
details.text: `[MEDIUM]`: no change is blamed. `test_dumper.py` hung for 2 h after item 234 of 249. A race in the grafter test helpers can hand out the same port twice, and the same hang has been seen on NVIDIA. It last passed in this lane on Nov 1. Fix: ✅ [#47974](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47974) (open since Nov 2).

details.label: R381
details.text: `[MEDIUM]`: no change is blamed.

TP3 stalled while lazily compiling the CI-only `_assert_nonneg_and_invalidate` (`overlap_utils.py:77`, `@torch.compile`). Meanwhile TP0–2 waited in the EAGLE verify broadcast, and the 300 s watchdog fired.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: this happened once. The same sglang commit [`55656628`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/55656628f0ad51e2320cfd50371c8accfda3449b) passed 23 h earlier. Fix: ❌.

details.label: R382
details.text: `[MEDIUM]`: no change is blamed. The job takes its own `linux-mi300-4gpu-sglang` runner down; per its analysis that happened in 14 of the last 15 runs. It gets an ID for the first time today. Fix: ❌. Suggested triage: runner owners should check host memory or shm on the pod around 08:21 UTC.
